title: Your first node, in V1 and in V3

questions.q: A V1 node's function returns the integer x, not (x,). What do you see when it runs?
options: The value is wrapped for you
TypeError: object of type 'int' has no len()
The node is skipped with no message
questions.answer: TypeError: object of type 'int' has no len()
questions.why: merge_result_data calls len on what you returned. We ran this. Validation can't catch it, because it never runs your function.

questions.q: What do the V1 and V3 forms of a node share by the time the validator sees them?
questions.why: The V3 base class builds that dictionary from your schema, in get_v1_info.

questions.q: Your node does image += 0.25. Each queue changes only a setting on your node. What happens to the picture?
options: It gets brighter on each queue
questions.answer: It gets brighter on each queue
questions.why: The input is the cached output of the node upstream, and you changed it in place. A real run went 0.3755, 0.6255, 0.8755.

questions.q: A pack defines both NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS and comfy_entrypoint. Which does the loader use?
questions.why: load_custom_node reads the mapping first and returns True, so the entry point is never called.

questions.q: You edit your node's Python while the server runs and queue again. What changes?
options: It reloads at the next queue
questions.why: Packs are imported once at startup, in init_external_custom_nodes.
